items.title: Pinterest shares fall on lukewarm sales guidance
items.description: Pinterest reported better-than-expected earnings and revenue for the second quarter, though its forecast was online in line with estimates.

items.title: AMD's revenue climbs 50% and data center sales doubled, but the stock is down
items.description: AMD's Data Center unit is driving the company's growth, up 107% over last year.

items.title: The stock market soars. 5 reasons behind the big surge Tuesday
items.description: The Dow had its best day in nearly two months and the S&P 500 rose to new highs.

items.title: Michael Burry bets against rally: 'We are near a major top, and possible a 1987-type fall'
items.description: "I continue to believe it is possible we are near a major top, and possible a 1987-type fall," Burry said in a Tuesday Substack post.

items.title: Lucid begins 'operational reset' as CEO says EV maker will delay midsize vehicle
items.description: The company didn't provide updated guidance. New CEO Silvio Napoli earlier this year suspended production expectations.

items.title: McDonald's says its U.S. business is falling short as it announces new head of its largest market
items.description: McDonald's stock has fallen more than 11% this year, dragging its market cap down to roughly $191 billion.

items.title: Wayfair stock jumps 30% as retailer posts strongest U.S. growth since 2020
items.description: Wayfair, a pandemic darling that's seen sales slow since lockdown orders were lifted, posted its strongest U.S. growth since 2020 during its second quarter.

items.title: Chipotle stock falls on potential link to salmonella outbreak in Minnesota
items.description: Chipotle has pulled the affected supply from restaurants and replaced them with peppers from different growers, according to the company.

items.title: Palantir stock skyrockets 29%, narrowly missing its best day ever after 'otherworldly' results
items.description: "Our customers have declined to become vassal states of the language labs," Palantir's co-founder and CEO Alex Karp said after blowout second-quarter earnings.

items.title: Paramount Skydance raises full-year profit guidance, remains 'confident' about WBD merger
items.description: Paramount Skydance reported second-quarter earnings after the bell and said it continues to prepare for its proposed merger with Warner Bros. Discovery.

items.title: TikTok users are sharing the items they say are always worth the money—here's what financial planners say
items.description: Financial planners weigh in on a recent trend on TikTok that has users sharing the items they swear are always worth the money.

items.title: Oil prices tumble after Bessent says Strait of Hormuz deal may come this week
items.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz would allow freedom of navigation.

items.title: An overlooked player in data center buildout delivers once again
items.description: Not only did results outpace expectations on both the top and bottom lines, but we also got a boost to full-year guidance.

items.title: Bessent says U.S. backed Japan’s yen intervention to help stabilize Asia
items.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. bought yen alongside Japan to curb currency volatility and reduce risks to Asian markets.

items.title: Bessent says there may be deal Tuesday or Wednesday to open Strait of Hormuz with 'freedom of movement'
items.description: "We are in talks with the Iranians," the Treasury secretary told CNBC's "Squawk Box."

items.title: Philadelphia Fed President Paulson content with rates at current level, but keeping an open mind
items.description: Paulson said voting with the majority last week wasn't a tough decision.

items.title: Blanche approved by Judiciary Committee, sending Trump's AG nominee to full Senate vote
items.description: Attorney General nominee Todd Blanche will still need to receive 50 votes on the Senate floor to be confirmed after clearing the Senate Judiciary Committee.

items.title: Pfizer tops estimates, hikes low end of revenue guidance on strength of Eliquis, other drugs
items.description: Pfizer said it cut its full-year revenue expectation for its Covid products to $4 billion, down from around $5 billion previously.

items.title: Abdul El-Sayed, Haley Stevens square off Tuesday in Michigan Democratic primary
items.description: Michigan's Senate Democratic primary between Abdul El-Sayed and Rep. Haley Stevens is one of the most closely watched races of the midterm election.

items.title: Procter & Gamble will acquire supplements brand Thorne for $3.8 billion, CEO tells CNBC
items.description: P&G CEO Shailesh Jejurikar said the acquisition is a play to grow the company's health business on CNBC's "Squawk on the Street."
